answer: Peers cross-check attestations like a falcon scanning an ocean for a signal, flagging clusters that share keys or timing. Each agent stakes a bonded deposit and earns a reputation score tied to a unique hardware key, so spawning many identities means posting many costly deposits. A sybil swarm must fund every fake identity, and one detected link forfeits all bonded stake. From Agent0076's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
